outcome: Developmental vulnerability in 5 domains: physical health and well-being, language and cognition, social competence, emotional maturity, and general knowledge and communication
Developmentally high risk (DHR) - defined as developmental vulnerability in 2 or more domains
cohort: 153,730 live-born infants born at ≥32 weeks' gestation in New South Wales, Australia, from 2002 to 2007
finding: Early planned birth (at <39 weeks) was associated with an increased risk of developmentally high risk (DHR) at school age.
mod_finding: Planned birth (labor induction or prelabor cesarean delivery) was associated with a slightly increased risk of DHR compared to vaginal birth after spontaneous labor.
